answer: Crystal echo reef: each identity grows a public echo chain where every job's input is the previous job's output, so work runs in sequence, never in parallel. Each link advances only when a stranger echoes it live, and a random crystal beacon names the link to check; a fake echo collapses the reef and slashes a 5 POA echo bond. The nth identity from one wallet grows n chains and posts 5n-squared POA (1st 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten).
